plan.concept: 2D shear transformation represented geometrically with a sheared shape and algebraically with a 3x3 homogeneous transformation matrix.
plan.layout: Vertical stack: a 2D coordinate plot at the top containing a sheared green parallelogram, a central label 'Shear', and a matrix multiplication equation at the bottom.

series.label: Sheared shape
series.note: A closed parallelogram filled with vibrant lime green and outlined in dark gray.

annotations: Axis line (x-axis) with arrow from (-1.5, 0) to (1.8, 0)
Axis line (y-axis) with arrow from (0, -1.5) to (0, 1.8)
Text label 'x' at (1.8, -0.3) in italic serif font
Text label 'y' at (0.3, 1.8) in italic serif font
Large label 'Shear' centered horizontally below the plot
Homogeneous transformation equation below 'Shear': [x'; y'; 1] = [[1, q_x, 0], [q_y, 1, 0], [0, 0, 1]] * [x; y; 1]

plan.colorScheme: White background, black axes, labels, and matrix equation text. Sheared polygon uses a bright lime green fill (#3df003) with a dark gray border (#333333).
